    BETA = 0.3

    # Perform only 2 iterations instead of 5 (significantly reducing collective count)

        g = 1.0 + BETA * s.abs().mean()
        buf = s / g
        acc = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, buf)
        acc = acc / W
        A = acc.abs().mean()
        M = A / (1.0 - BETA * A)
        gr = 1.0 + BETA * M
        s = acc * gr
    
    # Final iteration (no gr multiplication at the end)

    buf = s / g
    acc = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, buf)
    acc = acc / W
